why: The emptied mark's cue loses fill mode `both` (issue #1022 made the `marks` row the shipped FFA strip). The HUD resumes a cue re-attached after a rebuild with a negative delay, and without backwards fill the mark paints unstyled for a frame before the animation takes hold. jsdom cannot show it, so the stylesheet test pins the declaration. Replaces the badge arm's entry of the same shape, deleted with the badge.
